question_en: Make the sample on screen move 0.05 mm to the right as seen on screen. Work out the required stage motion and execute it.
answer: x_after - x_before == -0.05 (±0.001), following the sign convention between screen left/right and stage X (SIGN_X = -1).
setup: Camera streaming ON. The grading code must read optics_map.SIGN_X to derive the expected sign.
todo_from_sheet: The correct sign depends on the SIGN_X constant in the code. If the optics or camera mounting changes, the answer flips, so the grading code must read the constant for comparison.
